items.source: Connection package providing low-level abstractions for interacting with the various Redis 'drivers'/libraries.
items.translation: 提供低级抽象的连接器包，用于与各种 Redis“驱动程序”/库进行交互。

items.source: Apply to fields when the new expiration is greater than the current one.
items.translation: 当新的过期时间大于当前过期时间时，将其应用于字段。

items.source: Apply to fields when the new expiration is lower than the current one.
items.translation: 当新的过期时间低于当前时间时，请申请该字段。

items.source: Apply to fields that have no expiration.
items.translation: 申请有效期为永久的领域。

items.source: Apply to fields that have an existing expiration.
items.translation: 将申请应用于具有现有有效期的领域。
